title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21

ai_review.summary: Decent early‑70s audience tape that captures a lively show highlighted by Easy Wind, Not Fade Away and St Stephen.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source with the typical haze of a 35‑year‑old tape, but it remains listenable and even charming despite some cuts (Not Fade Away, Good Lovin) and occasional drop‑outs. Musically the show delivers strong moments—especially Easy Wind, a soaring Not Fade Away into St Stephen, and the overall free‑wheeling ’70 rock vibe that fans love.

ai_rating.rationale: A solid performance with several standout songs earns a decent score, while the audience tape quality and mixed reviewer opinions keep it from higher ratings.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Typical early‑70s audience tape haze; some cuts (Not Fade Away, Good Lovin) and occasional drop‑outs noted, but overall clear enough to enjoy the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rock‑heavy ’70 set with a freewheeling rush; solid first half leading into an energetic jam that builds to Not Fade Away and St Stephen, delivering the classic Dead vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is remembered for his relaxed vibe on the veranda—smoking a joint—and his guitar work during Easy Wind.
